record.body:
## Rationale

The core guarantee is that the test author is not the agent that benefits. Git ordering and path allowlists catch the common rewrite; different SSH commit signers close the principal gap when history is signed.

## Counter-argument

Manifest-stored oracle_commit fields would be explicit and easy to read. Without verifying them against git they are as forgeable as any other agent-edited file.

payload.alternatives: pure git ordering and paths without signer checks; store oracle_commit fields in the manifest without verifying git
payload.choice: verdict checks git history: oracle paths land before implementation, oracle commits touch only oracle/support paths, and when commits are SSH-signed the oracle signer differs from the implementation signer
